settings.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our products, delivery, payments, and returns.
settings.answer_1: We deliver orders within 3–7 business days depending on your location.
settings.question_2: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
settings.answer_2: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available on selected products and locations.
settings.question_3: What is your return and exchange policy?
settings.answer_3: We offer easy returns and exchanges within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging.
settings.question_4: How can I track my order?
settings.answer_4: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via SMS or email.
settings.answer_5: Yes, all our products are carefully selected and quality-checked before delivery.
settings.question_6: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer_6: You can refer to our size chart available on each product page to find your perfect fit.
settings.answer_7: Yes, we use secure and trusted payment gateways to ensure safe transactions.
